notes.title: Recent changes
notes.content:
Dear community,
The following changes have been performed:
[list]
[*] rewritten the store page and the minimum/recommended hardware specifications
[*] configured and enabled Steam Cloud synchronization for savegames, in order to continue a saved game from a different computer
[*] disabled a disimproving framerate optimization feature
[*] fixed an issue which does not count any playtime without the use of external software
[*] recreated a video sequence
[*] enabled the automatic DirectX installation
[/list]

notes.title: Displacement Studios taking over
notes.content:
Dear community,
[url=http://www.displacementstudios.com]Displacement Studios[/url] acquired [i]The Return Home[/i] and is going to make a few improvements to it. So far it is planned to:
[list]
[*] overhaul the map, influenced by community feedback
[*] rewrite the store page and recommended hardware specifications
[*] stop the game from offering a disimproving framerate optimization feature
[*] increase the in-game health automatically when the rabbit gets wounded
[*] fix an issue which does not count any playtime without the use of external software
[*] configure and enable Steam Cloud synchronization for savegames, in order to continue a saved game from a different computer
[*] recreate the video sequences and game trailer
[*] enable the automatic DirectX installation
[/list]
Any of these changes are likely being performed in the next few days and are implemented in some of our other games already. Stay tuned for the next update!
